plot: The morning after the photo Max wears his new red harness for Grandma's noon walk to the duck pond, but his legs 'forget' how to walk and Dog pulls him like a sled into a leaf pile; Mouse asks who decides where Max goes at home, Max follows a white feather and walks on his own as soon as he leads, and since Dog always follows Max, Max ends up walking Dog and Grandma to the pond right at twelve, then finds his favorite garden tree has lost its leaves.

script.title: A Cat on a Leash! Max's First Park Walk

beats.say: Come on, Max! Walk! Walk! It's the best thing ever!
Nope. I'm not walking. I'm a puddle now.
Max, it's only a harness. Just one little step?
It's a bright morning in the park, the day after the photo.
Max is wearing his new red harness for the very first time.
It feels like someone is hugging me. All the time.
It looks very smart on you, Max. Like a little hero.
Walks are the best, Max! Wherever you go, I go!
It's true. Dog always follows Max. To the kitchen. To the sofa.
He even followed Max to the bathroom once. Grandma wasn't happy.
At twelve, my friends meet at the duck pond. Big walk!
Everyone will see me walk? On a leash?
You have to walk all the way across the park, Max!
But Max has a cat secret. When cats wear a harness...
...sometimes their legs forget how to walk.
My legs are broken. Both of them. All four of them.
Max, you have four legs. That's two more than both.
Then all four are broken. Very, very broken.
No problem! I'll pull you. I'm a very strong dog!
Gently, Dog. Gently!
Too late. Dog runs. And Max slides behind him like a sled.
Wheee! I mean, help! I mean, wheee!
Swish, through the grass. Swoosh, round the bench...
...and FLUMP! Right into a big pile of leaves.
Max? Max! Where did you go?
I'm in here. I am a leaf now. Please leave me.
A cat-shaped leaf! With a red scarf!
Sorry, Max! Was that too fast?
Being pulled is the worst. Cats don't like to be pulled!
Oh dear. It's almost twelve, and the pond is far away.
Then I'll stay in the leaves. Forever. Goodbye, everyone.
Hmm. Max, can I ask you something?
At home, who decides where you go? You or Grandma?
Me, of course. I'm a cat. I go where I want.
And when Dog pulled you, who decided?
Dog decided. And I didn't like it one bit.
So maybe cats don't walk behind. Maybe cats walk in front!
In front? Like the boss of the walk?
Exactly. You choose the way. Your legs will remember.
Max climbs out of the leaves. He shakes off a red leaf.
Then he sees something. A white feather on the path.
Ooh. A feather. I must check that feather.
Step, step, step. Max walks to the feather all by himself.
Max! You're walking! On your leash!
Am I? I was just being curious!
Max is walking! Max is walking! Hooray!
Keep going! You choose the way, Grandma holds the leash.
So Max walks in front. Sniffing a flower. Checking a stone.
This way, everyone! This way is very interesting!
Look behind you, Max! Look who's following you!
Dog follows Max. Step for step. Just like at home.
And Grandma holds both leashes, trying to keep up.
Slow down, you two! My legs are older than yours!
Max! Are you walking me now?
I think I am! Follow me, Dog. To the pond!
Hurry, Max! Only two minutes until twelve!
Max takes a shortcut past the bench. Dog follows.
Grandma follows Dog. Mouse rides on Grandma's shoe!
Faster, Grandma! We're a walking train!
And they reach the duck pond just as the clock strikes twelve.
Look at all the dogs! And one cat leading the way!
My friends can't believe it. A cat who walks his dog!
Best walk ever, Max. You're a great boss.
Thanks, Dog. Tomorrow, you can be the boss. Maybe.
Being pulled was terrible. Choosing the way is wonderful.
Everyone walks better when they can follow their own nose.
Some friends like to follow. Some friends like to lead.
And a good walk has room for both.
That afternoon, Max walks all the way home. In front.
Home again! Now I'll climb my favorite tree in the garden.
But when Max looks up at his tree, his mouth falls open.
Grandma! My tree! Where did all the leaves go?
Is Max's favorite tree sick?

#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation

#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation
